verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is an official web app, and its docs say it is a Progressive Web App that can be added to a phone home screen, desktop taskbar or dock. Because it is the same app on every surface, the full feature set carries over, including voice calls, memory, channels and RAG. The docs also describe supervising agents from a browser away from the desk. Missing for 10: native desktop and mobile apps, any evidence on how mobile or PWA usability compares in practice, and independent hands-on corroboration of the multi-surface experience.
